I didn't record 382 seats for Marrow Agrisupply because it doesn't match the paperwork. I said so in a reply to Tobias in the #central-team thread.

The documents all point to 40 seats:
- The Affiliate Amendment, effective 15 Oct 2025, set Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats on SLA Tier 1.
- The 2026 Renewal Order Form, signed 22 Apr 2026 for the term 1 May 2026 to 30 Apr 2027, says Marrow Agrisupply's seats stay as that amendment set them.
- The account page, last updated 15 Sep 2026, also shows 40.

I asked Tobias to point me to a newer amendment or order form if 382 comes from a change I don't have. Until he does, 40 is the documented count.
